title: DynamicFont: Mixing CJK characters with brackets causes excessive DrawCalls due to font atlas pagination
body:
### Tested versions

## Issue Description

When using DynamicFont to render text that mixes CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) characters with brackets (both full-width `（）` and half-width `()`), Godot generates excessive DrawCalls even with a small number of labels.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create a project with a CJK font (e.g., simsun.ttc)
2. Create a LoopContainer or VBoxContainer
3. Add 10-20 labels with text like: `"物品名称（带括号）"` or `"Item (with brackets)"`
4. Observe DrawCalls in the debugger (can reach 100-200+ DrawCalls)

## Expected Behavior

DrawCalls should remain low regardless of whether brackets are mixed with CJK characters.

## Actual Behavior

DrawCalls explode when CJK characters and brackets are mixed:
- 10 labels without brackets: ~20-30 DrawCalls
- 10 labels with CJK + brackets: ~100-200 DrawCalls

## Root Cause Analysis

Godot's DynamicFont uses a font atlas for rendering glyphs. When the atlas page is full, it creates a new page, and each page requires additional DrawCalls. The issue is that:

1. CJK characters are rendered to one atlas page
2. Brackets (both full-width and half-width) are rendered to a different atlas page
3. Each text switch between these pages triggers additional DrawCalls

## Workaround (Current)

```gdscript
# Preload characters by rendering all needed characters at startup
func preload_chars():
    var vp = SubViewport.new()
    vp.size = Vector2i(2048, 512)
    add_child(vp)
    
    var label = Label.new()
    label.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
    label.text = "所有需要预加载的字符（括号）()"  # Include both CJK and brackets
    vp.add_child(label)
    
    await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
    await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
    vp.queue_free()
```

## Suggested Solution

1. Add a `FontFile.preload_chars(chars: String, size: int)` method to preload specific characters to the font atlas at runtime

2. Add a `FontFile.page_size` property that can be set at runtime (currently read-only after loading)

3. Document the font atlas pagination behavior and provide best practices for CJK text rendering

## Environment

- Godot version: 4.6.x
- Renderer: Forward+
- Platform: Windows/Linux/macOS
- Font: DynamicFont with .ttc/.ttf file

## Tags

`rendering` `font` `dynamicfont` `drawcalls` `performance` `cjk`
